mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Move objects from one transport task to another.

description: Moves the object entries named by objects from the transport task named by transport_number to the task named by target_number. Required: transport_number* (the source task), target_number* (the target task), objects* (at least one: object_name*, object_type*, position* in the source task's object list, pgmid). The positions come from a read of the source task's objects (object_type TRANSPORT). Response: JSON — acceptance only; a re-read of both tasks' objects (object_type TRANSPORT) confirms it. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

objects.description: The entries to move, at least one — each with object_name, object_type, position (in the source task) and an optional pgmid.

object_type.description: Object-directory type — CLAS, FUGR, TABL, DOMA — not an ADT type code like CLAS/OC.

pgmid.description: Program id. Defaults to R3TR, a workbench object's.

position.description: Position of the object's entry in the source task's object list.

target_number.description: Number of the transport task the entries move to.

transport_number.description: Number of the transport task that holds the entries.

name: HandlerTransportMoveObjects
